R <- params$results

## The model

A document is $N$ content lemmata drawn from the mixture $\sum_k \theta_k \phi_k$ with $\theta \sim \mathrm{Dirichlet}(\mathbf 1)$. The topic-word
distributions $\phi$ ($K \times V$) are **soft**: a lemma has probability under several topics, so every word is a mixture and the posterior
$p(\theta \mid \text{document})$ has no closed form. $\phi$ is fitted once on the three tragedians by a seeded latent Dirichlet allocation
(tomotopy), each seeded topic given a strong word prior on its seed lemmata, the five philological hypotheses or the 39 unsupervised clusters,
plus a few free topics.

**Amortization.** A word enters the likelihood only through its $K$ log-likelihoods $\log \phi_{\cdot w}$, so a document is a set of
$K$-vectors and a DeepSet summary network is the natural compression; a coupling flow (BayesFlow) learns $\theta$ in additive log-ratio coordinates
from 200,000 simulated documents. Before it reads the real documents it is checked on 1000 held-out simulations: recovery $R^2$, 90 % interval
coverage, and simulation-based calibration (SBC), whose rank histograms must be uniform if the posterior is calibrated.

The GPU work is done by `scripts/amortized_mixed_model.py` (`slurm/amortized_mixed_model.slurm`); this document reads its output in
`` `r R` ``.

```{r load}
phi  <- fromJSON(file.path(R, "phi.json"))
res  <- fromJSON(file.path(R, "hypotheses.json"))
cells <- read.csv(file.path(R, "hypotheses.csv"), encoding = "UTF-8")
sbc  <- read.csv(file.path(R, "sbc.csv"), encoding = "UTF-8")
rec  <- read.csv(file.path(R, "recovery.csv"), encoding = "UTF-8")
names_ <- phi$names; H <- length(res$real$p_dominant_seeded); K <- length(names_)
cat(H, "seeded topics (", res$topics, ") +", K - H, "free; vocabulary of", phi$vocab_size, "lemmata; LDA log-likelihood per word", round(phi$ll_per_word, 3), "\n")
```

## The topics

Top lemmata of every topic as the seeded LDA fitted them on the tragedians; the number of seed lemmata found in the vocabulary is given per seeded topic.

```{r topics}
tibble(topic = names_, seeds = c(sapply(phi$seeds_found, length), rep(NA, K - H)),
       top = sapply(phi$top_words[names_], function(w) paste(head(w, 10), collapse = " "))) |> knitr::kable()
```

## Calibration of the amortized posterior

```{r checks}
tibble(topic = names_, recovery_r2 = res$checks$recovery_r2, coverage90 = res$checks$coverage90, sbc_p = res$checks$sbc_p) |> knitr::kable(digits = 2)
```

```{r sbc, fig.height = 6, fig.width = 9}
show <- head(names_, params$show_topics)
sbc |> filter(topic %in% show) |> mutate(topic = factor(topic, show)) |>
  ggplot(aes(rank)) + geom_histogram(bins = 20, fill = "grey60") + facet_wrap(~topic, ncol = 4) +
  labs(title = "SBC rank histograms (uniform if calibrated)", x = "rank of the true theta among posterior draws", y = NULL) + theme_minimal(9)
```

```{r recovery, fig.height = 6, fig.width = 9}
rec |> filter(topic %in% show) |> mutate(topic = factor(topic, show)) |>
  ggplot(aes(true, post_mean)) + geom_abline(colour = "grey50") + geom_linerange(aes(ymin = q05, ymax = q95), colour = "grey80") + geom_point(size = 0.6) +
  facet_wrap(~topic, ncol = 4) + labs(title = "Recovery on held-out simulations (posterior mean and 90 % interval against the truth)", x = "true theta", y = "posterior") + theme_minimal(9)
```

## The lacunae

```{r cells}
cells <- cells |> mutate(cell = ifelse(restorer == "" | is.na(restorer), as.character(cell), paste(cell, restorer)))
if ("lift" %in% names(cells)) {
  raised <- cells |> filter(!is.na(p_above_sophocles), p_above_sophocles >= 0.9) |> arrange(cell, desc(lift)) |> group_by(cell, n_docs) |>
    summarise(raised = paste0(topic, " (", sprintf("%.1f", lift), "×, ", sprintf("%.2f", mean), ")", collapse = ", "), .groups = "drop")
  knitr::kable(raised, col.names = c("cell", "documents", "topics raised above Sophocles (P >= 0.9; lift, posterior mean)"))
}
```

```{r dominant, fig.height = 8, fig.width = 9}
cells |> mutate(topic = factor(topic, names_)) |>
  ggplot(aes(cell, topic, fill = p_dominant)) + geom_tile() + scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "firebrick", name = "P(largest\nseeded topic)") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = "Which seeded topic dominates each cell") + theme_minimal(8) + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))
```

```{r mass}
cells |> filter(cell %in% c("sophocles", "walk", "henry")) |> group_by(cell) |> arrange(desc(mean), .by_group = TRUE) |> slice_head(n = 5) |>
  select(cell, topic, mean, q05, q95, p_dominant) |> knitr::kable(digits = 2, caption = "Largest posterior means in the pooled cells")
```
